observations: Close-up of a sewing machine control panel.
The text 'EM81' is clearly visible in red on a black background in photo 0.
The machine has a black adjustment dial with a red ring.
The machine body is off-white or cream-colored.
A watermark 'NATHANZ SEWING EQUIPMENT' is visible across the center of the image.
The photo is a close-up, showing the control panel but not the full machine or its surroundings.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not be functional or may have internal mechanical issues.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on, the needle moving, and the motor running.

risks.risk: Essential accessories like the foot pedal, power cord, and bobbins may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing the complete machine with all included accessories.

risks.risk: The machine may be a counterfeit or a lower-spec model repackaged as an EMEL 81.
risks.proof: A photo of the machine's serial number plate and a clear shot of the brand logo on the machine head.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and sewing.
Photo of the full machine with all accessories included.
Photo of the machine's serial number plate.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified as an EMEL 81 from the photo. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional or missing parts) until proof of operation and completeness is provided.
